;====================================================================
; QSMC v6.6.22 - M5 SCALPER preset (EA: QSMC_AutoTrader)
; GENERATED by tools/generate_set_presets.py - do not hand-edit.
;
; WHAT THIS IS
;   A market-execution scalper plan on the M5 chart. The indicator keeps
;   its full TopDown/SMC chain; this file only changes the EXECUTION
;   envelope so the geometry fits an M5 stop instead of an M15 one.
;
;   stop 80..800 pts, RR@fill >= 1.30, break-even at +1.00R,
;   half banked at +1.20R, spread <= 25 pts, session 08:00-20:00 server,
;   6 entries/day, 1 position, 30 min cooldown after a loss.
;
; DEMO: ARMED.  InpEnableTrading=true + InpDryRun=false
; REAL: DISARMED. InpAllowRealTrading=false and both confirmations are
;   empty. Arming a real account needs ALL THREE, edited by you, on the
;   exact login and server of that account. This file never fills them in,
;   because a preset that knows your login is a preset that can arm itself
;   on a machine you did not configure.
;
; WHY THE RISK ENVELOPE IS TIGHTER THAN THE M15 PRESET
;   M5 produces more signals per hour. More signals at the same risk is a
;   bigger daily loss for the same edge, so the daily stop is 1.00% and
;   the hard ceilings stay 0.50 / 2.00 / 8.00.
;
; NOT A PROMISE. No backtest ships with this file. Read the
; [QSMC_ENTRY_REVIEW] lines on DEMO before you consider the real switch.
;====================================================================

; InpEnableTrading: ARMED on DEMO: the EA sends orders. A REAL account still cannot trade (see InpAllowRealTrading).
InpEnableTrading=true
; InpDryRun: false = really sends. true would log only.
InpDryRun=false
; InpMagic: unique magic so this scalper never manages the M15 preset's positions (20261027).
InpMagic=20261121
InpPinIndicatorDefaults=true
InpIndicatorName="nadir2"
; InpTradeComment: stamped on every ticket, so the journal and the chart agree which plan opened it.
InpTradeComment=QSMC-SCALP-M5
; InpAllowRealTrading: DISARMED. Set true ONLY after a DEMO period you have read the logs of, and together with the two confirmations below.
InpAllowRealTrading=false
; InpRealAccountConfirm: LEFT EMPTY ON PURPOSE: you type the EXACT login of YOUR real account. Empty = a real account can never trade.
InpRealAccountConfirm=
; InpRealServerConfirm: LEFT EMPTY ON PURPOSE: you type the EXACT broker server name. Empty = a real account can never trade.
InpRealServerConfirm=
; InpRealMaxRiskPercent: REAL profile per-trade cap: same 0.25%. Only used once a REAL account is fully authorized.
InpRealMaxRiskPercent=0.25
; InpRealMaxDailyLossPercent: REAL daily stop 1.00%.
InpRealMaxDailyLossPercent=1.00
; InpRealMaxAccountDrawdownPct: REAL account drawdown halt 4.00%.
InpRealMaxAccountDrawdownPct=4.00
; InpRealMaxAggregateRiskPercent: REAL aggregate open risk 0.50%.
InpRealMaxAggregateRiskPercent=0.50
; InpRealMaxOpenPositions: REAL: one position.
InpRealMaxOpenPositions=1
; InpRealMaxTradesPerDay: REAL: 4 entries/day, fewer than DEMO's 6.
InpRealMaxTradesPerDay=4
; InpMaxAggregateRiskPercent: 0.50% of equity across all open risk, HARD max 2.00%.
InpMaxAggregateRiskPercent=0.50
; InpLotMode: risk-percent sizing: the volume follows the stop, never a fixed lot.
InpLotMode=QSMC_LOT_RISK_PERCENT
; InpRiskPercent: 0.25% per trade. M5 stops are small, so this is a SMALLER money risk than the M15 preset's 0.10% on a wide stop.
InpRiskPercent=0.25
; InpMaxRiskPercent: same 0.25%: one number, so the input cannot drift above the plan. HARD ceiling 0.50% still wins.
InpMaxRiskPercent=0.25
InpFixedLots=0.0
InpFixedLotsMaxRiskPercent=1.0
; InpTPLevel: LEVEL1 = the indicator's nearest target. A scalper takes the first liquidity, not the third.
InpTPLevel=QSMC_TP_LEVEL1
; InpBreakEvenAtR: stop to entry at +1.00R: after that the trade cannot become a loss.
InpBreakEvenAtR=1.00
; InpUseTPPips: false = the indicator's structural target, not a guessed pip ladder.
InpUseTPPips=false
InpPipPoints=0
InpTP1Pips=100
InpTP2Pips=200
InpTP3Pips=300
InpTP1ClosePercent=40.0
InpTP2ClosePercent=40.0
; InpMoveSLToBEAtTP1: off: break-even is already handled by InpBreakEvenAtR (+1.00R), which fires earlier.
InpMoveSLToBEAtTP1=false
; InpMoveSLToTP1AtTP2: off: with LEVEL1 there is no TP2 ladder to step through.
InpMoveSLToTP1AtTP2=false
; InpMaxSpreadPoints: 25 pts. On M5 the spread is a large share of the stop; 60 (the M15 cap) would eat the edge.
InpMaxSpreadPoints=25
InpMaxSpreadFracOfStop=0.1
InpDeviationPoints=30
; InpMaxOpenPositions: 1. One M5 position at a time: a second entry in the same move is the same trade twice.
InpMaxOpenPositions=1
; InpMaxDailyLossPercent: 1.00% daily stop. Twice the per-trade risk, not ten times it.
InpMaxDailyLossPercent=1.00
InpMaxDailyLossMoney=0.0
; InpMaxAccountDrawdownPct: 4.00% from the equity high-water mark, HARD-bounded at 8.00%.
InpMaxAccountDrawdownPct=4.00
; InpStopAfterConsecLoss: 3 losses in a row stands the scalper down. M5 streaks are normal; 5 is not.
InpStopAfterConsecLoss=3
; InpResetBreakersAtInit: false: attaching never clears a breaker. Clearing one is a reviewed operator action.
InpResetBreakersAtInit=false
; InpPinTimeframeMinutes: 5 = this EA refuses to run on anything but the M5 chart. It never switches the chart itself.
InpPinTimeframeMinutes=5
InpMaxDataAgeSeconds=30
; InpMaxSignalAgeBars: M5 scalper plan (v6.6.22)
InpMaxSignalAgeBars=2
; InpMinStopPoints: M5 scalper plan (v6.6.22)
InpMinStopPoints=80
; InpMaxStopPoints: M5 scalper plan (v6.6.22)
InpMaxStopPoints=800
InpCloseOnOpposite=false
; InpMinRRAtFill: M5 scalper plan (v6.6.22)
InpMinRRAtFill=1.30
InpOrderRetryMax=3
; InpSessionStartHour: 08:00 server: London open. Asia produces M5 noise without follow-through.
InpSessionStartHour=8
; InpSessionEndHour: 20:00 server: stops before the late-NY rollover spread.
InpSessionEndHour=20
; InpMaxTradesPerDay: 6 entries. A scalper takes more trades than a swing plan, and this is still a hard, persisted cap.
InpMaxTradesPerDay=6
; InpCooldownAfterLossMin: 30 min after a losing close: shorter than the M15 plan's 60 because M5 setups expire, longer than a revenge click.
InpCooldownAfterLossMin=30
; InpPartialCloseAtR: bank half at +1.20R. M5 moves fast; taking something is how a scalp is not a swing.
InpPartialCloseAtR=1.20
; InpPartialClosePercent: 50% banked at InpPartialCloseAtR, the rest rides to the target.
InpPartialClosePercent=50.0
InpPollSeconds=2
InpVerbose=false
InpHeartbeatSeconds=300
InpHeartbeatLookback=200
; InpSignalExecutionProfile: BALANCED = STRONG + MODERATE. MODERATE publishes at 0.50x risk, so it is a smaller bet, not a looser rule.
InpSignalExecutionProfile=SIGNAL_PROFILE_BALANCED
; InpAllowWeakSignals: WEAK stays OFF: a 40-score scalp on M5 is noise, and the spread alone can exceed its edge.
InpAllowWeakSignals=false
; InpRequireProfileMatch: true: this EA refuses any class its own profile does not allow. It can only be stricter than the chart.
InpRequireProfileMatch=true
; InpWeakRiskMultiplier: 0.25x - unused while InpAllowWeakSignals=false.
InpWeakRiskMultiplier=0.25
; InpModerateRiskMultiplier: 0.50x: a MODERATE scalp risks half of base.
InpModerateRiskMultiplier=0.50
; InpStrongRiskMultiplier: 1.00x: a STRONG scalp risks the full 0.25%.
InpStrongRiskMultiplier=1.00
; InpOwnExecutionLane: true: claims a cross-EA ownership global per signal, so two EAs on one terminal cannot open the same trade twice.
InpOwnExecutionLane=true
; InpPrintEntryReview: true: prints the 12-condition checklist before every order attempt. This is the log you read on DEMO.
InpPrintEntryReview=true
